prompts.Target:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Unity 2D tower-defense hit-effect animation sprite sheet. Create ONE exact 6-column by 5-row atlas, 30 square cells, each 256x256 pixels, total image 1536x1280. Read frames left-to-right, top-to-bottom. The sheet is ONE continuous 2.5 second animation at 12 FPS, not a concept board of different designs. Every frame keeps the same fixed impact origin, scale and camera. True transparent RGBA background. No text, numbers, lines, separators, borders, grid, checkerboard painting, background panels, characters, enemy, tower, floor, scenery or shadows. Each cell has 20px empty transparent safety margin. Every particle stays INSIDE its cell, never connects adjacent cells. Style: clean chunky game VFX with precise cel shaded shapes, 2-3 colors and crisp pointed sword-cut edges; readable small, no photorealism, no smoke or blurry fog, restrained glow. Reference image is only old sword effect STYLE reference: preserve crisp readable contours, replace the blue cross aesthetic with the requested planned motif. Animate a clear progression; DO NOT repeat identical icons or draw a single effect spanning the full sheet.
Theme: sword TARGET skill, Korean 24-form plum blossom sword technique (이십사수매화검법). Palette petal pink, deep rose-pink, bright ivory white, tiny warm gold glints. Only ENERGY SLASHES and plum petals, no physical sword, no floral border, no branch.
Frames 1-24: rapid successive compact sword slashes strike the SAME center, exactly one fresh cut per frame. Alternate diagonal /, backslash, short horizontal, curved crescent angles rhythmically, each new fresh ivory razor slash accompanied by a thinner faint pink echo of the previous slash and a few 5-petal plum blossom petal fragments scattering. Fast slashes are sharp and slim with rose trailing edge, not giant thick filled blobs. Build modest intensity across frames, last cut frame24 is a crisp X finishing flash with pink petals. Maintain a small clear center, leave negative space.
Frames25-30: no new strikes, progressively fewer and smaller scattered drifting pink petals and tiny ivory glints, dissolving to nearly empty frame30, clearly decaying, no new bright blooms. Row1 frames1-6 onset, row2 frames7-12 brisk cuts, row3 frames13-18 escalating cuts, row4 frames19-24 finishing cuts, row5 frames25-30 fade. Exact equal 6x5 grid with transparent gutters.
